title: Did You MISS Nvidia? The Next Winner Is Hiding in Plain Sight | Feat. Couch Investor
creator: Couch Investor
summary: A Future Investing conversation with Neil (Couch Investor) covering macro (possible Fed hike, oil-driven inflation, the Clarity Act failing cloture) and AI names. Neil argues Nvidia's bull case is intact despite 'AI extinction' fears: if any single lab falters, compute demand just shifts elsewhere; semis' weakness is a buy-the-dip in quality names since all are still catching up to demand. He calls Meta 'ridiculously undervalued' (~$640-650 vs an '$800 stock'), SoFi 'still very undervalued', and says he's leaning harder into Nu Holdings (New Bank: $1B buyback, forward PE ~14, US entry). His disclosed book: ~50% Nvidia (biggest bet; $250 year-end bet vs ~$212), a sizable Micron position (avg ~$90, house money after taking chips off post-$1,000, put 30% back ~$950; expects a buyback by Q1'27), Nebius (bought back a covered call after the dip), DLO, SOFI, NU, a recently started small Oracle position, and more Axon bought on a 10% dip after a $1B 0% convertible. He pitches Broadcom as 'the next Nvidia' (AI solutions doubling in 2027 and again in 2028 per CEO guidance, PEG ~0.5). Calls: NVDA, AVGO, MU, META, SOFI, NU, ORCL, AXON, GOOGL all BUY (Couch); DLO and NBIS UNCERTAIN (holds both, no explicit stance). Note: auto-caption speaker boundaries are merged in several exchanges; Broadcom-pitch attribution to Couch inferred from end-of-video holdings cross-check.
